task_completion.description: Load the human PTEN crystal structure (PDB: 1D5R) into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '1D5R' or 'pten' and a protein structure is visible in the viewport.

task_completion.description: Distinctly color the Phosphatase domain (14-185) and the C2 domain (190-350).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The protein structure shows two large, contiguous regions colored differently from each other (e.g., blue and red).

task_completion.description: Highlight the five specific mutation residues: C124, G129, R130, C211, and D331.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Five specific residues are rendered in a different style (e.g., spheres or sticks) or a contrasting color compared to the rest of the domains.

task_completion.description: Measure CA-CA distances from C124 to G129, R130, C211, and D331.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Dashed lines (measurement wizards) are visible in the PyMOL viewport connecting C124 to the other four residues, with distance labels displayed.
The terminal or PyMOL log shows a 'png' or 'export' command targeting the specific path: ~/PyMOL_Data/images/pten_mutations.png.

task_completion.description: Write a structural report mapping mutations to domains and recording the 4 distances to ~/PyMOL_Data/pten_mutation_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows a report containing the mutation names, their respective domains (Phosphatase or C2), and the numerical distance values.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL GUI or command line to perform actions rather than just creating files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application active with the structure being manipulated, not just a file manager or text editor.

integrity.description: The report content should match the measurements taken in the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The distance values shown in the PyMOL viewport labels must match the numerical values written in the final .txt report.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific requested file paths for output.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands or file dialogs show the exact paths: ~/PyMOL_Data/images/pten_mutations.png and ~/PyMOL_Data/pten_mutation_report.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1D5R. The Phosphatase domain spans residues 14-185 (contains C124, G129, R130). The C2 domain spans residues 190-350 (contains C211, D331). The output figure must be at least 40,000 bytes and the report must be at least 10 lines long. The report must map C124, G129, and R130 to the Phosphatase domain, and C211 and D331 to the C2 domain.
